notes: Isolates needle-in-context retrieval against a ~19 KB / 240-record synthetic logbook delivered inline (plain mode has no filesystem, so the corpus lives in prompt.md). Confound removed: no arithmetic, no inference - the answer is three fields of one line. Distractors are near-miss drift values (0.0930, 0.0094, 0.0039, 0.0103, 0.0092) so fuzzy or prefix matching lands on the wrong record, and the needle sits at record 190 of 240 so boundary guessing fails. Tier 1: exact-match search; strong-model prior >= 90%, which is why 3 independent fields (id, bearing, surname) are required rather than one. Grading scope: final 'FINAL:' line only. False-positive audit: (a) the planted near-miss records' fields (drift 0.0092/0.0039/0.0103/0.0094/0.0930), (b) station instead of operator, (c) a boundary record, (d) no FINAL line - all rejected. a numerically identical entry=0190/entry=190 is accepted, since leading zeros are not significant and formatting is not this task's target skill.
